subject: general
question: Nashik is also known as ________ capital of India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Wine.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nashik** is known for its wine production and is referred to as the** "Wine capital of India."**
 
• Nashik's pursuit of becoming the wine capital of India received a significant boost when the Indian government bestowed it with the prestigious **Geographical Indication (GI) tag**. To further promote wine production, the city has been branded as** "Nashik Valley Wine." **
 
• The city's favorable **climate, fertile soil, and proximity to the Sahyadri mountain ranges** make it ideal for **grape cultivation.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gold:**

 
 
• **Mumbai and Kolkata **are renowned for their **gold trading and jewelry manufacturing industries** in India.
 
• These cities have a long-standing history and reputation for gold-related businesses, including **gold bullion trading, jewelry design, and craftsmanship.**
 
 
 
• **Orange:**
 
 
• **Nagpur**, known as the **"Orange City,"** is famous for its high-quality oranges in India.
 
• The region's **unique climate and fertile soil **contribute to the cultivation of delicious and flavorful oranges.
 
• Nagpur is recognized as a prominent orange-growing region in India and produces a significant portion of the country's oranges.
 
 
 
• **Cotton:**
 
 
• **Ahmedabad**, located in Gujarat, is widely recognized as the major **cotton hub in India.**
 
• The city has a thriving cotton textile industry and significant cotton production.
 
• Ahmedabad is home to the **Cotton Corporation of India (CCI) **and serves as a prominent center for cotton trade and manufacturing.
